attempted_claim: Let M=F8(-1,2) be the closed hyperbolic 3-manifold obtained by -1/2 (equivalently (-1,2)) Dehn surgery on the figure-eight knot complement m004 (H_1=Z/5, volume ~1.0147). Does M admit a C^2 transversely oriented codimension-one foliation with an exceptional minimal set, equivalently a local minimal set that is neither a compact leaf nor the whole manifold? The scope is all C^2 codimension-one foliations on this fixed closed manifold M, Reeb components allowed. A complete answer is either an explicit C^2 foliation on M with a certified exceptional minimal set witnessed by a resilient leaf with contracting linear holonomy and a Markov-partition verification that the minimal set is exceptional, or a proved theorem that no C^2 codimension-one foliation on M has an exceptional minimal set (e.g. every Reebless C^2 foliation on M is minimal or has a compact leaf forcing a classified topology).
decisive_failure: No explicit foliation with certified exceptional minimal set was constructed and no nonexistence theorem was proved; the three concrete routes (fibered extension, local plug, homological/Floer obstruction) were each exhausted with documented negative outcomes, and the bounded IFS plus homology computation only localizes the blockage rather than resolving the existence question on M.
